title: A Part History status entry reads with or without a note
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create two active parts for this test, part A and part B.
  • Give parts A and B part numbers that start with the same text, so one search lists both.
  • Start on the Inventory page (Parts in the top bar, then Inventory in the left menu), on the Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Type the shared start of the part numbers in the Search box.
  2. Click the part A row.
  3. Click Inactive under Part Status.
  4. Click Save.
  5. Type Worn out in the Note (Optional) field.
  6. Click Deactivate in the confirmation.
  7. Click the part B row.
  8. Click Inactive under Part Status.
  9. Click Save.
  10. Click Deactivate in the confirmation.
  11. Click the Inactive tab.
  12. Click the clock icon (Part History) at the left of the part A row.
  13. Go back to the Inactive tab.
  14. Click the clock icon (Part History) at the left of the part B row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Parts A and B are listed.

Step 2:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part A.

Step 3:

  • Inactive is picked.

Step 4:

  • The confirmation opens.

Step 5:

  • The note reads Worn out.

Step 6:

  • Part A leaves the Active tab.

Step 7:

  • Edit Inventory Part opens for part B.

Step 8:

  • Inactive is picked.

Step 9:

  • The confirmation opens; leave the note empty.

Step 10:

  • Part B leaves the Active tab.

Step 11:

  • Parts A and B are listed on the Inactive tab.

Step 12:

  • Part A's newest entry reads "Deactivated | Reason: Worn out".

Step 13:

  • The Inactive tab shows again.

Step 14:

  • Part B's newest entry reads "Deactivated" with nothing after it (no "| Reason:").

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10823 (Story 10, Confirming and Recording a Status Change)

  • S10-R17: “The entry reads "Deactivated" or "Activated". When the user gave a note it reads "Deactivated | Reason: {note}" or "Activated | Reason: {note}". With no note it reads "Deactivated" or "Activated" and nothing more.”
